spec.title: About this view

options.content:
Can users reach a usable application, and where is the request path failing?

Missing or partial evidence is Unknown. [Runbook](https://github.com/iT3E/tnwks-ops/blob/main/docs/network/access.md)

spec.description: Purpose, scope and the interpretation of missing evidence.

spec.title: Application probe state
spec.description:
Content probe to the in-cluster Service on its active site. This bypasses client DNS, ingress and sign-in; those paths need separate evidence.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: HTTP requests
spec.description:
Rate counters before aggregation. Use the same scope when comparing the error numerator and total denominator.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: HTTP 5xx fraction

spec.expr: sum by (k8s_cluster, ingress) (rate(nginx_ingress_controller_requests{k8s_cluster=~"$cluster",status=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (k8s_cluster, ingress) (rate(nginx_ingress_controller_requests{k8s_cluster=~"$cluster"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.description:
Weighted errors/requests. No traffic is not a perfect availability measurement; independent synthetic evidence remains necessary.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: HTTP p95 duration
spec.description:
Buckets combined before calculating the percentile. Never average per-pod percentiles.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Name state by site
spec.description:
Each site's collector uses every shared-VIP name as a client would: the router's DNS answer must be the name's VIP, TLS must verify, and that site's ingress must route the host (any answer but a 404 or 5xx). A pod reaches its own site's ingress for either VIP, so this is each site's readiness to serve the name.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Served by
spec.description:
The site each ingress said served the request (its X-Homelab-Site header). It matches the observer's site, because each site's pods reach their own ingress.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Name certificate remaining
spec.description:
Certificate the client saw for each name, per site. Under 14 days alerts; cert-manager renews at 30.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Analytics health
spec.description:
Plausible's health API per component (Postgres, ClickHouse, sessions, the sites cache), polled by its exporter. The Plausible probe on User paths is the independent check.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Visitors today
spec.description:
Unique visitors per tracked site so far today (Plausible's day period, in the site's time zone). It resets at midnight, so read it as a running count.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Page views today
spec.description:
Page views per tracked site so far today.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Bounce rate today
spec.description:
Share of today's visits that viewed one page, per tracked site. Zero with no visits.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Visit duration today
spec.description:
Average visit duration today, per tracked site. Zero with no visits.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Certificate validity remaining
spec.description:
Expiry of certificates managed by cert-manager. S3 transport trust and external identity-provider health are separate checks.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Tunnel connections
spec.description:
Cloudflared connection evidence. This does not by itself certify the origin, identity provider or application content.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.
